body_text: We value your time with family, and building community with children and families.

items.title: Working Saturdays & Events
items.text: Second Saturday is a working day, 8:00 am to 1:00 pm, for professional development. Teachers also join about 2–3 occasional Saturday events a year.

items.title: Holidays & Planned Breaks
items.text: Diwali Break, Christmas Break, Summer Vacation, National and Festival Holidays. The annual calendar is shared at the start of each academic year.
